title: Uttarakhand HC questions State over release of detained adult activist "into custody of his mother"
description: The Uttarakhand High Court on Monday questioned the actions of the Uttarakhand Police to release an adult detenue "into the custody of his mother" instead of being set free.A Bench of Justices Ravindra Maithani and Siddhartha Sah also asked the State to explain the very basis for his detention.
